evidence_kind: Steinberg VST3 host automation software contract and existing CS80 public parameter ranges; not a hardware measurement
sdk_source: JUCE 8.0.11 pinned c352e2489000ffeb9e397051377d75eef2efe641, pluginterfaces/vst/ivstparameterchanges.h IParamValueQueue: piecewise-linear segments and implicit previous point at sample -1
plugin_parameter_source: src/core/Params.h kGlobalDefs: P_volume [0,1], P_brilliance [-2,2], P_resonance [0,1]; all NormalisableRange skew 1

truth_model.input_format: 32-bit VST3 host audio, one mono input and two output channels, sustained MIDI note 60 from a deterministic 3 x 256 sample prelude
truth_model.reference_first_half: 128 consecutive 1-frame host process calls; each receives exactly one point at offset 0 and value 0.8 + (0.2-0.8)*i/128 for i=0..127
truth_model.reference_second_half: One 128-frame call with an offset-0 point at normalized 0.2
truth_model.float_conversion: Each host point is double precision; the JUCE parameter receives float-normalized values. The engine performs its existing global-settings mapping, macro offset and circuit SmootherBank retargeting at the start of every corresponding host sample.
truth_model.independence: Two freshly created VST3 components render the same prelude before the 256 vs 128x1+128 comparison. Full-block and microblock voices are never the same instance.

mutations.ramp: Suppress the volume queue or hold its last point for the full 256 frames; reference difference must exceed the declared minimum.
mutations.ramp_brilliance: Suppress the brilliance queue or hold its last point for the full 256 frames; reference difference must exceed the declared minimum.
mutations.ramp_resonance: Suppress the resonance queue or hold its last point for the full 256 frames; reference difference must exceed the declared minimum.
mutations.flat_sample: No automation must remain exactly equivalent across a 256-frame and 128x1+128 partition; do not weaken this control to make an automation gate green.

status_at_registration: truth-model only; these new gates have not been evaluated. No performance or hardware measurement is claimed.
